rationale: Glucose and lactate are abundant primary substrates. Arginine and cysteine provide supplemental N and C. Ammonium is limited (~8.7 mM) and constrains growth. Mixed-acid fermentation of sugars and amino acids yields acetate, butyrate, formate, CO₂, and H₂. Carbon balance: 75 mmol in − 19 (growth) − 57 (products) ≈ 0. Nitrogen: 6 mmol in − 5 (growth) = 1 mmol margin. Growth rate of 0.50 /h is conservative but sustainable over 4 h in this N-limited batch.
